# Manish S Consulting

> Independent IT consultancy in Pune, Maharashtra, India. We build AI solutions, automation, web applications, cloud infrastructure and DevOps for startups, SMBs and agencies. Fixed prices, written scope, one accountable partner.

Website: https://manishsconsulting.tech
Contact: info@manishsconsulting.tech

## Services
- [AI Solutions](https://manishsconsulting.tech/services/ai): knowledge assistants, document processing, LLM features, support automation
- [Automation](https://manishsconsulting.tech/services/automation): integrations, workflow automation, internal tools, data pipelines
- [Web Development](https://manishsconsulting.tech/services/web-development): web apps, APIs, marketing sites, e-commerce
- [Cloud](https://manishsconsulting.tech/services/cloud): cloud architecture and migration
- [DevOps](https://manishsconsulting.tech/services/devops): CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring
- [IT Solutions](https://manishsconsulting.tech/services/it-solutions): ongoing technical support
